name: Theory of Linear and Nonlinear Elastic Solids
description: Introduction to tensor algebra; kinematics of deformation; stress tensor; Cauchy theorem; Cauchy stress and Piola stress tensors; principal stresses; governing equations; constitutive equations; linear elasticity theory; plane stress and plane strain; Airy’s stress function; strain compatibility; finite elasticity; invariance; neo-Hookean and Mooney-Rivlin models; boundary value problems in linear and finite elasticity.
